result.topic_en: Magnetic inclination (dip) observations made on 10 May with needle No. 4 (pole B north), where pairs of circle readings are averaged, combined into quantities a and b, and compared with values for needle 3 and with dates in 1841 and 1842.

methods.what: Arithmetic mean of four circle readings (e.g. 112.18.30, 21.30, 18.15, 18.45) taken as the averaged reading
Inclination value formed as the mean of the paired readings, defining corrections b and a
Solving for a and b from their sum and difference: b = ((b+a)+(b−a))/2, a = ((b+a)−(b−a))/2
Averaging four inclination results to obtain the mean for each needle (Nadel 3 and Nadel 4), then the combined mean
